image_description: A black, wedge-shaped stage monitor loudspeaker system. It features a dual-chamber design with two large woofers at the bottom and three smaller high-frequency drivers (tweeters/horns) arranged above them. The brand name 'Triton' is visible in white text on the central divider. The enclosure appears to be made of textured black material, likely carpeted wood or plastic.
